Tools for LLM agents

pppower_mcp_tools.Rd

Returns the main pppower design calculations as tool definitions created with ellmer::tool(), so that an LLM agent (for example through ellmer::chat_anthropic() or an MCP client) can plan prediction-powered studies. Each tool takes inputs in planning terms (effect size, number of unlabeled units, \(R^2\), or sensitivity and specificity) and returns the required labeled sample size or the power, together with the classical comparison and the main assumptions.

Usage

pppower_mcp_tools()

Value

A list of ellmer tool objects.

Details

The tools are:

ppi_mean_design

One-sample mean or prevalence.

ppi_two_sample_design

Difference of two means.

ppi_two_proportion_design

Difference of two proportions.

ppi_paired_design

Paired mean difference.

ppi_2x2_design

Odds ratio or relative risk in a 2x2 table.

ppi_planning_inputs

Converts reported metrics (MSE, sensitivity and specificity, a pilot correlation) into conservative planning inputs.

Regression contrasts need pilot covariance blocks and are not exposed as a tool; use power_ppi_regression() directly.

Each tool returns a JSON object (as a character string) with named fields.

See also

pppower_mcp_server()

Examples

tools <- pppower_mcp_tools()
vapply(tools, function(t) t@name, character(1))
#> [1] "ppi_mean_design"           "ppi_two_sample_design"    
#> [3] "ppi_two_proportion_design" "ppi_paired_design"        
#> [5] "ppi_2x2_design"            "ppi_planning_inputs"
